title: 背負い式の落ち葉ブロワー
description: 公園管理や歩道清掃に使う背負い式ブロワー。背面パッドと肩ベルト、ファンの吸気ガード、小型原動機、蛇腹ホース、操作グリップと中空ノズルを備えます。人、落ち葉、送風・騒音・燃焼・柔軟物の挙動は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.592 × 0.634 × 1.477 m、17,116三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A backpack blower for park care and sidewalk cleanup, with back pads and shoulder straps, a guarded fan intake, small power unit, flexible hose, control grip and hollow nozzle. No person, leaves, airflow, sound, combustion or flexible-body behavior is supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.592 × 0.634 × 1.477 m; 17,116 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
